en:
What's up? Your face says you got 
something to say to me.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Ryoma for a while?

Hmph...did you come to lecture me 
about not having the will to live?

I'll sit and listen if it'll make you 
feel better...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time talking
with Ryoma...
<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma and I grew a little closer today.
